posts.title: The AI Race Ends in a Refinancing
posts.description: If the 2027 to 2029 correction arrives, it starts as a credit event in the machinery financing AI datacenters, not as a bad quarter at a big lab. Here is the sequence, the casualty list, and what survives it.

posts.title: Every Junior Job Was Secretly Two Products
posts.description: AI now does the work juniors used to learn on, so firms have rationally stopped hiring juniors. The bill arrives around 2035, roughly a decade after the last moment anyone can act on it.

posts.title: You Cannot Own a Falling Floor
posts.description: Inference cost at a fixed capability fell 100 to 1000 times in two years, on a published schedule. Any product whose moat is model access has about two years of shelf life.
